about: The judges: files that decide whether another change is good enough (scripts/gate-changes.mjs, .github/workflows/gate-changes.yml).

A pull request that changes one must disclose it in the trailer block (the last paragraph) of one of its commits: `Gate-change: <file or glob> — <reason>`. A trailer is a disclosure for the person reviewing, never an approval.
This list and the script are always read from the pull request's base, never from the pull request: a change can't loosen the judge that judges it.
path: a file or a glob (`*` within a folder name, `**` as a whole folder name: any number of folders). report: listed in the summary, never failed.
